resolution.note: task check dead-after finding; t-czn62h3 re-pointed

title: Task check refuses an open task waiting on a dependency closed other than done
body:
Why: t-czn62h3 (R49) never became ready: its after task t-kmsa30s was closed as duplicate of t-czn62h3 itself, and ADR 0015 says only a done closure unblocks, so the task waited forever with nothing reporting it.
Outcome: `krn task check` (run in CI) refuses an open task ordered after a task closed as dropped, duplicate or superseded, naming the `krn task dep rm` (and `dep add` to the duplicate's ref) that fixes it; ADR 0015 semantics unchanged; t-czn62h3 re-pointed.
Proof: test/task/task-check.test.ts dead-after case; node src/cli/main.ts task check exit 0.
Scope: src/task/, test/, docs/adr/0015, tasks/.
